raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Fixes #43162. `--dtype float32` (and its alias `"float"`) are advertised, parser-accepted choices, but no FlashInfer attention kernel exists for fp32: the JIT module URI map (`filename_safe_dtype_map` in `flashinfer.jit.utils`) covers fp16/bf16/fp8/integer dtypes only. The engine loads the weights, enters CUDA-graph capture, and dies with a bare `KeyError: torch.float32` from `get_batch_decode_uri`, taking the whole process group down with an unactionable message.

## Modifications

`FlashInferAttnBackend.__init__` now validates the resolved model dtype before touching any runner state and raises a `ValueError` that names the supported dtypes and points at `--dtype float16/bfloat16` or `--attention-backend torch_native`. Same failure class as before, but raised at backend init instead of mid-capture, with the remediation in the message.

New CPU unit tests pin the gate, the message content, and that backend construction raises before reading any pool/config state.

## Accuracy Tests

No model output path changes; the gate only rejects a configuration that never produced output.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A; one dict-free tuple membership check at backend construction.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). (`pre-commit run` on both files, all hooks pass)
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). (3 tests + subtests, registered for base-a-test-cpu)
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). (the argument and its help text stay valid for backends with fp32 support)
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). (N/A, see above)
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## To verify

Local verification was CPU-only: the new tests pass against the fix and fail when the gate is neutralized (red-green). I have no local GPU, so the fp32-plus-FlashInfer incompatibility itself is asserted from FlashInfer's JIT dispatch source, and the end-to-end engine startup path is left to CI.

files.patch:
@@ -291,6 +291,22 @@ def fast_prefill_plan(
     self._plan_info = self._cached_module.plan(*args)
 
 
+# FlashInfer's JIT dispatch has no float32 entry, so an fp32 model only
+# surfaces as a bare KeyError deep in CUDA-graph capture. Gate it up front.
+_FLASHINFER_SUPPORTED_MODEL_DTYPES = (torch.float16, torch.bfloat16)
+
+
+def _validate_model_dtype(model_dtype: torch.dtype) -> None:
+    if model_dtype not in _FLASHINFER_SUPPORTED_MODEL_DTYPES:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"The FlashInfer attention backend does not support model dtype "
+            f"{model_dtype}; its kernels are compiled for float16 and bfloat16 "
+            f'only. Run with --dtype float16 or bfloat16 ("auto" downcasts '
+            f"float32 checkpoints to float16), or pick an attention backend "
+            f"with float32 support, e.g. --attention-backend torch_native."
+        )
+
+
 class FlashInferAttnBackend(AttentionBackend):
     """Flashinfer attention kernels."""
 
@@ -307,6 +323,7 @@ def __init__(
         init_new_workspace: bool = False,
     ):
         super().__init__()
+        _validate_model_dtype(model_runner.dtype)
         self.prefill_backend = "fa2"
         self.decode_backend = "fa2"

@@ -0,0 +1,47 @@
+import unittest
+from unittest.mock import MagicMock
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.flashinfer_backend import (
+    FlashInferAttnBackend,
+    _validate_model_dtype,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class TestFlashInferModelDtypeGate(CustomTestCase):
+    """--dtype float32 is accepted by the argument parser, but FlashInfer has
+    no fp32 attention kernel, so the engine used to die with a bare KeyError
+    from the JIT dispatch table during CUDA-graph capture. The backend now
+    rejects the dtype at construction with an actionable message."""
+
+    def test_supported_dtypes_pass(self):
+        for dtype in (torch.float16, torch.bfloat16):
+            with self.subTest(dtype=dtype):
+                _validate_model_dtype(dtype)
+
+    def test_float32_rejected_with_guidance(self):
+        for dtype in (torch.float32, torch.float):
+            with self.subTest(dtype=dtype):
+                with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as ctx:
+                    _validate_model_dtype(dtype)
+                message = str(ctx.exception)
+                self.assertIn("float16", message)
+                self.assertIn("bfloat16", message)
+                self.assertIn("torch_native", message)
+
+    def test_backend_init_gates_before_any_state(self):
+        # A bare runner mock carries no pools/config; reaching anything past
+        # the dtype gate would raise AttributeError instead of ValueError.
+        runner = MagicMock(dtype=torch.float32)
+        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as ctx:
+            FlashInferAttnBackend(runner)
+        self.assertIn("float32", str(ctx.exception))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
